editorial.blurb: Koyaki is a welcoming Japanese spot with fresh, beautifully prepared bowls and viral sandos that has won over even Asian-food skeptics with its exceptional service and genuine hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask Abbas or Saqib for a menu guide on your first visit—they'll steer you toward the spicy soba bowl and their famous sandos, and the team often surprises guests with complimentary treats like mochi or canned drinks when they run out of regular options.

topDishes.note: Perfect sweetness with a contrast of cool, light cream against warm, crunchy fried bread
Delicious and packed the perfect punch for spice lovers
Decadent dessert sando with a thick sugar crust
